item.title: Broncos retain 27-year old running back for two more years
item.description: The Denver Broncos have re-signed running back J.K. Dobbins on a two-year, $20 million contract, according to Tom Pelissero.

item.title: Veteran TE Hayden Hurst retires after seven seasons in NFL
item.description: Veteran tight end Hayden Hurst is retiring from the NFL after seven seasons with the Ravens, Falcons, Bengals, Panthers, and Chargers.

item.title: Pittsburgh Steelers sign 1,000-yard rusher to two-year deal
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers are signing 1,000-yard rusher Rico Dowdle to a two-year, $12.25 million deal, according to Tom Pelissero.

item.title: Kansas City Chiefs sign AFC North safety to bolster secondary
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs have signed safety Alohi Gilman to a three-year, $24.75 million deal, according to Tom Pelissero.
